title: An alternative way of defining finite graphs
summary: In this paper we introduce "graph linear notation" -- a complete graph invariant -- which is positioned as an alternative definition for the finite graphs. This invariant is constructed using an algorithm similar to the algorithm of finding canonical forms of graphs. Storing graph linear notation instead of a regular graph allows us to greatly simplify two major problems: the construction of illustrations for graphs with regards to possible graph symmetries, and the comparison of two graphs for isomorphism.
